[LNLS.3.3a] **The anchor must pin the full key on both sides.** A
cross-pattern equality that does not pin the complete declared `key`
of a `logical` schema on each side is a compile error. Joining on a
non-`key` slot, or on part of a composite key, admits more than one
live fact per matched value, so `J_max > 1` and the join is not
bounded.
